objective: 验证：神经网络的泛化行为能否作为 bootstrap 解空间刚性的探针。这是纯数学/机器学习命题，研究对象就是小型前馈神经网络本身，严禁替换为材料、化学或玻璃体系。待测关系：在给定抽象约束族下，小容量网络见过有限约束样本后，在未参与训练的留出约束点上是否零违规，以及该临界模型容量随网络容量如何变化。请用可复现的数值实验给出证据。

input_params.description: Explore the design space for small-capacity feedforward networks to test the hypothesis that bootstrap solution space rigidity enables zero-violation generalization on held-out constraints. Systematically vary network capacity (width/depth), constraint types (linear/convex), and bootstrap sample sizes to identify critical capacity thresholds where generalization error drops to zero. Use numerical experiments to quantify the relationship between model capacity and solution space rigidity.
input_params.expected_prediction: The critical network capacity (neurons) for zero-violation generalization will scale logarithmically with bootstrap sample size, with distinct thresholds for linear vs. convex constraint families. Violation rates will show a sharp transition from >0% to 0% at the critical capacity point across multiple random seeds.

input_params.description: Validate the hypothesis regarding Ca/Si/Al/O glass conductivity by running a Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulation pipeline to compute ion mobility and conductivity as a function of Ca concentration, specifically testing the percolation threshold at 15 mol%. The workflow includes: (1) generating glass structures with varying Ca content (5-25 mol%) via melt-quench MD, (2) running NVT production runs to collect ion trajectories, (3) calculating mean squared displacement (MSD) and conductivity using the Einstein relation, and (4) analyzing the Ca-O-Ca network connectivity to identify percolation thresholds. This requires careful equilibration and convergence checks before property calculation.
input_params.expected_prediction: The simulation will reveal a sharp increase in Ca ion conductivity at Ca concentration between 12-18 mol%, correlating with the formation of percolating Ca-O-Ca networks. The calculated activation energy will decrease significantly above the threshold concentration.
